name: Sh2-106 (Hubble)
blurb: Sh2-106, a star-forming nebula, seen by Hubble.
label: s106-hubble
story: A massive young star, IRS 4, hidden in a dusty cocoon, blows out twin lobes of hot gas, while a ring of dust and gas pinches the nebula into an hourglass. The spread wings give this nebula its nickname, the celestial snow angel.

claims.text: S106, also Sh2-106 or Sharpless 2-106, is a bipolar star-forming region
A massive young star, IRS 4, drives it
The central star, also called S106 IR, sits in a dusty cocoon
Twin lobes of hot gas stretch from the central star
A ring of dust and gas pinches the nebula into an hourglass
It looks like a celestial snow angel
